name: hrbvhd-pairing-poll
goal: A transient relay poll failure leaves the pending browser pairing available for approval within the 20 second window.

title: Inspect sibling pairing clients and retry loops for the same failure.

evidence: The Google Device Linking spec defines transient poll recovery on the same pending request and the original 20-second deadline.
The connect method test ended before polling; the account Devices browser fixture always approved the first poll. Both existing cases now exercise a one-off relay failure.
Committed test at 87397fdfb4 failed on the unchanged service: expected the same poll through approval and one exchange, observed only the request and first poll.
Fix 23940629c3 retries status 0, 408, 500, 502, 503 and 504 on poll only. Late approval, cancellation and terminal states end the attempt before exchange.

Exact-snapshot 23940629c3 passes the unchanged 87397fdfb4 regression and command. The service methods and real pairing protocol use a synthetic relay. Covers one exchange after recovery, no replay of a failed exchange, 403, denial, cancellation, timeout and late approval.
